title: Weekly Club Sync Every Friday at 5:00 PM in Room H808
author: Arun 'devzero' Patel
content: Welcome to all new and returning members of FOSS Club KIET! Our primary weekly meeting takes place every Friday at 5:00 PM in Room H808 (CSE-AI / AI&ML Department). During these sessions, members share lightning talks on recent open source discoveries, review pull requests, and plan upcoming project sprints.
Additionally, our space in H808 is open every single day right after your classes conclude. Drop in anytime to work, discuss or ideate.
